question: The cost price of the article is 20% less than the marked price of the article, If he allows 20% discount on the article, then find the profit or loss percentage earned by the shopkeeper.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let the Marked Price (MP) of the article be 100 units. Since the Cost Price (CP) is 20% less than the MP ⇒ CP = 100 − 20 = 80 units. The shopkeeper allows a 20% discount on MP ⇒ SP = 100 − 20 = 80 units. Since CP = SP (80 = 80), there is neither a profit nor a loss. **∴ The correct answer is No profit no loss.**
